summary: # Marvelous Designer 10: Learning Day Special Guest UV-Zhu & New Features Demonstration ## Introduction In this video, we explore the new features of Marvelous Designer 10, featuring a special guest, UV-Zhu. The demonstration covers various functionalities, including the virtual model editor, adjustments, and new tools for creating and modifying garments. ## Virtual Model Editor First of all, the primary function is the virtual model editor. Before that, I want to tell you that we have updated some pre-set clothes and other items in the software. You can download them by clicking the download button in the upper left corner. This includes virtual models and other assets. ### Adjusting Model Attributes After opening a virtual model, you can adjust the height and chest size of the model in the virtual model editor. When you choose an attribute, the corresponding attribute in the 3D window will be displayed in yellow. The path is also available on B站 (Bilibili). You can choose the type of detail attribute, for example, a human model. The feature of the human model allows for extensive adjustments. However, since this is a detailed adjustment, even a slight change can make a significant difference. Thus, I suggest using the basic settings first. You can also choose the unit angle for adjustments. ## Creating Garments When making clothes, it’s essential to first search online for the type of clothes you want to create, then find matching patterns. The patterns you generally find on the internet usually correspond to real-life clothing. For example, if you search for a large dress, it may specify that the height is between 1.6 to 1.65 meters. ### Standard Sizing For example, if a girl wearing a large dress is 1.65 meters tall with a chest measurement of 84 centimeters, this is considered a standard size. Just to clarify, when creating clothes, there is indeed a standard size. You can enter the height and width, then fit the clothes onto a normal model body. After fitting, you can use the automatic adjustment tool to modify the garment according to your model’s body shape. The virtual model editor allows you to save the adjusted sizes for future use. ## Importing and Deforming Models I haven't done a live broadcast for a long time, so I am a bit nervous today. We can now insert a virtual model, which is an OBJ model. In this current version, after inserting an OBJ model, we can use the deformation axis to modify the model in three directions. Previously, you might have needed to open ShiftX for this, but now it's not necessary. ### Coordinate Center Additionally, there is an option in the right-click menu to move the model to the coordinate center with a single click. I will demonstrate how to create a test suit. Whether it’s automatic wear or automatic adjustment board, it all relies on the model’s test suit information to perform deformations. ## Measurement Lines We will first create a test suit and then follow the reference position in our image to draw a measurement line on the virtual model. The measurement line we commonly use consists of three points, and it will create its own measurement line. If we accidentally draw the measurement line incorrectly, we can simply right-click to delete it. Each time you create a measurement line, it corresponds to the clothing version, which will be automatically generated. ### Symmetry and Adjustments For example, if your model is symmetrical, that’s excellent; however, if it isn’t, you can turn off the symmetry feature to measure some dimensions between the left and right arms. ## Automatic Dress Adjustment Once the test suit is created, you can see a strange red suit on the model. You can drag it to ensure it tightly wraps around your model without any weight. After this, you can use the model information from Sichuan for further adjustments. ### Simulation and Particle Diameter When opening a project file worn by our default virtual model, regardless of the new version of the Sichuan service or adjustment functions, you must switch between two models with Sichuan service information. To speed up the simulation, we first increase the particle diameter to 20, allowing for a quicker simulation. After completing the simulation, you will find that the size of the version will be changed, matching the new model you just imported. ## Dynamic Features and Adjustments In this new version, we have added a dynamic fold function. If you open the carving mode, it will automatically create a dynamic stroke brush by dragging the brush. You can adjust the size of the dynamic stroke brush and the focal point to create realistic effects. ### Texture and Material Adjustments In the latest version, we also support Substance textures. You can import SBSAR files into Marvelous Designer, which allows for high-quality rendering materials. Additionally, we now have a unified texture option. This feature detects your UV picture, so if you change the UV layout in the UV editor, the texture will also change accordingly. ## Conclusion The new features in Marvelous Designer 10 provide enhanced capabilities for garment creation and modification, making it easier to achieve realistic designs. The tools covered in this demonstration highlight the software's versatility and efficiency, allowing users to express their creativity with precision and ease. For those interested in exploring these features, don’t forget to visit the official website for a one-month free trial.
